Alex Arce.note: Arce is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Alex Arce.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Alexandro Maidana.note: Maidana's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Alexandro Maidana.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Andres Cubas.note: Cubas's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Andres Cubas.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Antonio Sanabria.note: Sanabria's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Antonio Sanabria.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Braian Ojeda.note: Ojeda's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Braian Ojeda.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Damian Bobadilla.note: Bobadilla's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Damian Bobadilla.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Diego Gomez.summary: Diego Gómez is a Paraguay central midfielder from Brighton & Hove Albion who gives the national team powerful carrying, midfield shooting, and box-to-box range.
Diego Gomez.note: Gómez's edge is using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Diego Gomez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Fabian Balbuena.note: Balbuena stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Fabian Balbuena.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Gabriel Avalos.note: Watch Ávalos for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Gabriel Avalos.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Gaston Olveira.note: Olveira's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Gaston Olveira.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在危险出现前组织好队友上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Gatito Fernandez.note: Fernández is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Gatito Fernandez.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Gustavo Caballero.note: Watch Caballero for explosive speed once open grass appears. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Gustavo Caballero.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Gustavo Gomez.note: Watch Gómez for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Gustavo Gomez.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Gustavo Velazquez.note: Velázquez's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Gustavo Velazquez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Isidro Pitta.note: Pitta's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Isidro Pitta.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jose Canale.note: Canale's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Jose Canale.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Juan Jose Caceres.note: Cáceres's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Juan Jose Caceres.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Julio Enciso.note: Enciso's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Julio Enciso.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Junior Alonso.note: Alonso stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Junior Alonso.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Kaku.summary: Kaku is a Paraguay attacking midfielder from Al-Ain who gives the national team left-footed creativity, final passes, and set-piece service.
Kaku.note: Kaku's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Kaku.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Matias Galarza.note: Watch Galarza for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Matias Galarza.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Mauricio.note: Maurício's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Mauricio.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Miguel Almiron.note: Almirón's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Miguel Almiron.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Omar Alderete.note: Alderete's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Omar Alderete.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Orlando Gill.note: Gill stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Orlando Gill.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ramon Sosa.note: Sosa stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ramon Sosa.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
